en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing scenes from a small European village or small town. The main upper‑left image depicts a simple Romanesque or early Gothic stone church with a tall square tower, surrounded by a churchyard cemetery with many gravestones. Other panels show half‑timbered houses along a main street, a central traffic island or small square with an obelisk‑like monument, a row of modest modern single‑storey buildings, and a larger village house or inn with a loading canopy and parked car. The architecture is rural and vernacular, dominated by timber‑framed houses and narrow paved streets. No printed caption text is visible on the front.
